title: Webcam Light Burn Hours vs Meeting Load
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=elgato:keylight) OR (index=personal sourcetype=calendar:event meeting_status=completed)
| eval light_minutes=if(sourcetype="elgato:keylight",on_minutes,0)
| eval meeting_minutes=if(sourcetype="calendar:event",duration_minutes,0)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(light_minutes) as light_minutes, sum(meeting_minutes) as meeting_minutes by _time
| eval ratio=round(light_minutes/meeting_minutes,2)
| sort - _time
description: Compares how long the webcam light stayed on with how much meeting time actually happened that day.
value: A big gap between meeting minutes and light burn time often means setup waste, forgotten lights, or burnout-heavy call patterns.
implementation: Normalize meeting and Key Light durations into daily totals and alert on unusually high light-to-meeting ratios.
visualization: Line chart of daily meeting minutes and light minutes with a ratio overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It counts whether the camera light is running much longer than your actual meetings really require.
